baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2, 4-8, and 11 move from dispatch through a paired commission, joint denial, strengthening by a third, and a collective spoken claim.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first two form a mutually corroborating unit. Denial targets both together, so the third does not replace either one; it completes and strengthens the same commission, whose unchanged content is then voiced by the enlarged group.

activation_trace.role: The bearer-and-message sense makes the opening dispatch and closing self-description one shared commission.
Joining one to one supplies a paired unit whose members can corroborate one another.
Attributing falsity to both members creates the precise pressure answered by reinforcement.
Causative strengthening supplies the repair operation applied to the denied pair.
The completing third turns the pair into a reinforced three without changing the commission.
Overt utterance is the coordinated output of the now-strengthened group.

changed_reading.before: Two envoys are rejected, so an additional envoy is sent.
changed_reading.after: A jointly denied pair is converted into a stronger corroborative structure; the third reinforces the standing commission rather than beginning a different message.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated dispatch root at words 2 and 11 surrounds denial at word 5 and renewed strengthening at words 6-7.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant but focus-rooted motion image treats denial as an interruption rather than a terminal verdict. Successive dispatch, stoppage, and added completion make sentness restartable: the mission persists by taking another outward step.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups supply a serial rather than one-time model of dispatch.
Motion that runs and then stops gives denial an exploratory image of interrupted progress.
Strengthening restarts the checked movement by adding support.
The completing third is the next serial step through which dispatch continues.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a fixed mission that happens to gain one member.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages dispatch as restartable motion: reception can halt one wave, but reinforcement reissues the movement in another member.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The move from the paired number at word 4 to strengthening and a third at words 6-7 makes the numerical change functional.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair is an initial arrangement; the third changes its mechanical class. Alternate focus branches picture a three-part cord and a third hearth support, while the strengthening root contributes solidity, so the added member can be read as a load-bearing completion rather than mere surplus.

activation_trace.role: The joined pair supplies the initial two-part arrangement.
Material firmness makes reinforcement a gain in stability and load-bearing capacity.
A three-part cord supplies one material model in which the third changes structural strength.
A third hearth support supplies an alternate model of the added member completing a stable base.
The common commission is the load that the strengthened three-part structure carries.

changed_reading.before: The third is an interchangeable backup for either of the first two.
changed_reading.after: The third reconfigures the pair into a stable carrier of one commission; addition changes structure, not only headcount.

context_deltas.mechanism: Surah-level obstruction relocates failure from the dispatched message to the receiving system. The audience is enclosed, cannot see, and later cannot move forward or return; against that closure, adding a third preserves outbound motion on the sender's side.

activation_trace.role: Release and outward dispatch make the mission the moving element in the mechanism.
Interrupted running supplies an exploratory focus image for denial as checked reception.
Added strength preserves the outward initiative when reception is blocked.
Barriers that close gaps place obstruction around the audience rather than inside the commission.
Failed ocular seeing identifies a disabled receiving faculty.
Inability to pass onward supplies the later image of arrested forward motion.
Inability to return completes the audience's two-directional immobility.

structural_cues: 36:8-10 cluster bodily enclosure, front-and-back obstruction, and non-seeing around the recipients.
36:67 pairs inability to proceed with inability to return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recipient-side barriers and immobility; I infer that focus denial is a blocked receiving event and that the third preserves sender-side motion. A live alternative is that the barriers only characterize culpability and do not model transmission.

changed_reading.before: Denial shows that the first mission failed and needed replacement.
changed_reading.after: Denial exposes a closed receiving system; reinforcement keeps dispatch moving without conceding that the message or its first bearers failed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The completing third does not seal a closed trio. A later man arrives under purposeful motion, calls for following the messengers, and thereby extends the mission from externally sent bearers into an internally joined relay.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups let the focus trio serve as one stage in an expandable relay.
The third completes the immediate pair while leaving the commission capable of further uptake.
The later man's actual arrival adds a new participant after the completed trio.
Purposeful movement makes his joining active rather than incidental.
Following supplies the social mechanism by which recipients can enter the messengers' direction.
The contextual messenger occurrence reconnects the new follower to the serial dispatch pattern.

structural_cues: 36:20 places a locally arising supporter after the 2-plus-1 reinforcement and has him summon his people to follow the messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later arrival, purposeful movement, and a call to follow; I infer that the focus's numerical completion enables social continuation rather than numerical closure. Alternatively, the man may be only an independent supporter after the trio is already complete.

changed_reading.before: The third closes the messenger count at a self-sufficient three.
changed_reading.after: The third completes a resilient core that can generate a relay, allowing a recipient to become the next active carrier of its direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus expands warning from two to three, whereas later closure repeatedly needs only one cry. Mercy and temporal extension sit between those poles, making messenger multiplicity look like deliberate redundancy that prolongs address before an irreversible singular event.

activation_trace.role: The initial pair begins a numerically redundant field of address.
The completing third enlarges warning before closure rather than accelerating closure itself.
A terrifying cry supplies the decisive closure event contrasted with patient human address.
Singularity makes closure require less numerical mediation than warning.
Merciful tenderness supplies the motive for preserving an interval of address.
A bounded interval supplies the temporal space in which repeated warning remains possible.

structural_cues: The focus escalates from two to three speakers; 36:29 and 36:53 each compress terminal action into one cry.
36:44 explicitly joins mercy to continuance until a time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies numerical expansion in warning, singularity in closure, and merciful temporal extension; I infer that the asymmetry makes the third a mercy-bearing redundancy. The alternative is that the numbers serve unrelated narrative scenes.

changed_reading.before: The third is added only because two agents were operationally insufficient.
changed_reading.after: The third embodies surplus opportunity for address: warning is multiplied and prolonged, while final closure is starkly singular.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trio's collective declaration enters a delayed evidentiary arc. Immediate denial does not adjudicate the claim; later the messengers are declared truthful, and a separate scene redistributes speech and testimony from sealed mouths to limbs.

activation_trace.role: Bearer and message fuse the group's identity claim with the commission whose truth is contested.
Their overt utterance supplies the initial testimony awaiting adjudication.
Fulfillment that verifies word and act supplies retrospective confirmation.
The later messenger occurrence identifies the very class whose disputed commission is vindicated.
A sealing that prevents ordinary speech supplies an evidentiary transfer away from the mouth.
Intelligible speech from another source shows that testimony can survive a closed channel.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the surah's explicit later adjudicative mode.

structural_cues: 36:15-16 dispute and repeat the mission claim; 36:52 retrospectively certifies the messengers.
36:65 separates mouth, speech, and witness across multiple bodily sources.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an initially disputed utterance, later verification, and redistributed testimony; I infer that the focus trio functions as a durable evidentiary plurality whose claim need not win immediate assent. An alternative is that the later scenes concern different speakers without a shared testimonial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The three simply repeat a claim meant to persuade their immediate audience.
changed_reading.after: Their plural declaration is testimony with deferred adjudication: local denial cannot erase a commission later verified within a wider witness system.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated signs activate the focus branch in which a thing's state itself communicates. The trio therefore says its claim twice: propositionally through speech and configurationally through the visible fact that denial produced reinforcement rather than withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: A thing's state functioning as indication lets the reinforced arrangement communicate alongside uttered words.
The completing third makes the group's changed configuration the visible content of that indication.
An evident sign activates nonverbal states as communicative evidence.
A second explicit sign frame confirms that configured events can bear meaning.
A witnessing mark supports the broader mechanism of evidence carried by a state or trace.

structural_cues: 36:33, 36:37, and 36:41 repeatedly introduce configured natural events as signs.
In the focus, the third appears before the group restates its unchanged commission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated sign framing and a focus branch for nonverbal indication; I infer that the 2-plus-1 configuration itself signifies sender persistence. The live alternative is to restrict the focus saying to ordinary vocal speech.

changed_reading.before: Only the envoys' sentence communicates their mission.
changed_reading.after: Their unchanged sentence and their reinforced presence jointly communicate: the words assert sentness, while the added third visibly enacts its persistence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a personnel sequence onto a hearth and ignition process. It remains anchored in the focus's denial-to-strengthening sequence and its third-support branch, while 36:80 supplies green material, fire, and ignition; downstream prose should label it a cross-domain material analogy, not a lexical translation or a claim that rejection literally causes revelation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The tightly linked words 5-7 place reinforcement with a third immediately after joint denial.

activation_trace.role: The attribution of falsity supplies the opposed pressure from which the analogy begins.
Added strength converts opposition into increased capacity rather than withdrawal.
The third hearth support makes the added member an exploratory stabilizer for contained transformation.
Living green material supplies one side of the context's surprising material reversal.
Kindled fire supplies the opposed energy released from that material.
Active ignition supplies the directional image for denial being followed by intensified manifestation.

changed_reading.before: Rejection is a setback answered by a numerical backup.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, rejection becomes the pressure point at which the mission intensifies: the third acts like the missing hearth support that lets opposed material yield sustained fire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it aligns messenger language with milk and water supply. It remains focus-anchored through independent dispatch, failed-yield, strengthening, and three-vessel branches, and whole-surah springs and drinking reactivate the material field; downstream prose must present it only as a hydraulic or pastoral analogy, never as the verse's lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Dispatch at words 2 and 11, denial at word 5, strengthening at word 6, and the third at word 7 form a flow-stoppage-repair-capacity sequence.

activation_trace.role: A continuing milk yield gives dispatch an exploratory supply-flow image.
Milk that unexpectedly ceases supplies a precise material image for denied transmission as interrupted yield.
Strengthening supplies the repair applied after the flow fails.
A three-vessel yield image makes the third an exploratory increase in supply capacity.
Wide splitting and outflow reactivate the focus analogy as a network whose channels can be opened.
A flowing water source supplies the contextual reservoir for restored transmission.
An apportioned share of water frames reception as access to a sustaining supply.

changed_reading.before: The third is extra personnel added after an audience rejects two speakers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the mission behaves like a supply network: a sent yield is interrupted, reinforcement adds capacity, and the third restores dependable delivery to a resistant receiving field.

strongest_changes: The third converts a jointly denied pair into a resilient evidentiary structure rather than merely increasing headcount.
Whole-surah singular closure makes the focus's two-to-three expansion read as merciful redundancy and extended opportunity for address.
Later verification and bodily testimony defer adjudication of the messengers' claim, so immediate denial cannot settle its truth.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the focus arithmetic functional: pair, third, repeated sentness, blocked motion, local following, singular closure, and deferred witness generated distinct but coexisting readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The third can still be modeled primarily as corroborative witness, restored transmission, or load-bearing completion.
The later man's role may extend the dispatch relay or may remain an independent response to an already complete trio.
The ignition and restored-yield readings are branch-grounded material analogies, not proposed lexical translations.
